newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM SAYS SOLD LASSILA & TIKANOJA.
newsitem.headline: UPM SAYS SOLD LASSILA & TIKANOJA.

text.p: Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said on Monday it had sold all its shares in plastic and cleaning equipment maker Lassila & Takkanoja Oy.
"We have sold -- we have dissolved our holding," UPM spokesman Markku Franssila told Reuters in response to a question.
There was no information about who the buyer was.

On September 20, Lssila said UPM's ownership in the group had fallen to 6.4 percent of shares and votes. Repola Oy, which formed UPM-Kymmene through a merger with Kymmene Oy, was the biggest owner in Lassila & Tikanoja on February 15, 1996, with 13.4 percent of shares and votes.
